description.value: Champions Guild Automation: Killer's Fortune: when an enemy you can see drops to 0 Hit Points, the module gives you Advantage on your next attack roll before the end of your next turn. Power from Pain: once per turn while Bloodied, an attack that hits deals extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus (added by the module).

automation.notes: Champions Guild Automation: Killer's Fortune and Power from Pain by the module.
